abstract: Build or harden a ScaleDock MCP server: an OAuth 2.1 resource server per the MCP authorization spec, JWT verification, RFC 9457 errors, and PermDock deciding, filtering, validating, approving and auditing every tool call. It installs the mcp-authorization, oauth, jwt and problem-details spec skills and defers to them on protocol details; references/stack.md maps each requirement onto the ScaleDock stack.
